about: The calibration set of the review (document 06, section 8): invented texts with one seeded defect each and clean texts where every finding is a false alarm. The set carries no name: {customer}, {person}, {mail} and {domain} are filled with names the runner invents from random letters for each run, {vendor} from rules/vendor-names.txt. `awb review calibrate` runs the script steps (writing, names, l0, keep) and lists the cases that need the review workflow or the price API. Target: every seeded defect caught by some step, at most two false alarms on the clean texts.
